title: Grandfather's Clock
commons_title: File:"Grandfather's Clock" by Henry C. Work – sung by the Edison Quartet (1905).ogg
composition: words and music by Henry Clay Work (1876); public domain
credit: Performed by the Edison Quartet; this recording is public domain on Wikimedia Commons.
lyrics: My grandfather's clock was too large for the shelf
So it stood ninety years on the floor
It was taller by half than the old man himself
Though it weighed not a pennyweight more
It was bought on the morn of the day that he was born
And was always his treasure and pride
But it stopped short, never to go again
